entries.zh: 山间的沟壑、山谷；山中（山里）
entries.en: ravine or gully in the mountains; mountain gorge
entries.notes: M 栏「que」与「裡」(lāi) 音不协，疑为「山區／山溪」之误写，释义据 L 栏「Quebrada del monte」与 H 栏「山裡」。

entries.zh: 海底；海中浅滩、暗礁（低潮处）
entries.en: sea bottom; shoal or shallow ground in the sea
entries.notes: L 栏「Baja a el mar」指海中浅处，H、M 两栏仅作「海底」，二者不完全对等，调合为「海底的浅滩」。

entries.zh: 小沟壑；小缺口（汉字栏作「含梢」，词义待考）
entries.en: small ravine; small crack or notch (Chinese column reads 含梢; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 「含梢」非经见之词，释义据 L 栏「Quebradico」（小沟壑）与 M 栏音写推定。

entries.zh: 裂缝；缺口、瑕疵（玉、瓷器上的破损）
entries.en: a crack; a chip or flaw (as in jade or porcelain)
entries.notes: 汉字栏「[疑:珀/珆]」残损，据 L 栏「Quebradura y melladura」（裂缝与缺口）及 M 栏「tiam」（玷，玉瑕）推定为破损、瑕疵之义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: 汉字、闽南语、官话三栏俱空，仅存西语词头「Quebrado, y. petra」，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 违法；违犯律法
entries.en: to violate the law; to break the law
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅存「違」一字，余字残去；释义据 L 栏「Quebrantar la ley」与 M 栏「hoan lue」（犯律）补足。

entries.zh: 破阵；击溃敌阵（亦用于击退魔鬼的阵势）
entries.en: to break the enemy's ranks; to rout the opposing host (also of demons)
entries.notes: L 栏「alexerábico」为「al exército」之讹写，后句「conguar」当读作 conjurar，义为击破敌方阵势。

entries.zh: 故犯；故意违犯（律法）
entries.en: to offend deliberately; to violate wilfully

entries.zh: 明知故犯；明知而故意违犯
entries.en: to break the law knowingly and with deliberate intent

entries.zh: 犯法；轻率违犯律法（汉字「無主」词义待考）
entries.en: to break the law; to violate it heedlessly (Chinese 無主; sense uncertain)
entries.notes: L 栏「timcui dar」疑为「sin cuydado」（不经意）之讹写；「犯法無主」于闽南语文献罕见，姑存其疑。

entries.zh: 犯禁；违犯禁令
entries.en: to violate a prohibition; to break a ban

entries.zh: 犯法；违犯法律
entries.en: to break the law; to offend against the law

entries.zh: 故违；故意违逆、明知故犯
entries.en: to disobey wilfully; to violate deliberately

entries.zh: 犯律；违犯律条
entries.en: to violate a statute; to offend against the law

entries.zh: 破戒；违犯戒条、誓愿（越出界限）
entries.en: to break a precept or vow; to transgress a bound

entries.zh: 为风邪所伤、肢体不能转动；风气（风邪致病）
entries.en: stricken by the wind so as to be unable to move; a wind-induced ailment
entries.notes: L 栏「quebrantado del viento」属旧医「风邪致病」之谓，H 栏「風氣」与之相应，非指自然之风。

entries.zh: 风气痛；风邪所致的疼痛（风湿痛）
entries.en: wind-induced pain; rheumatic ache
entries.notes: M 栏末音「ca」与「痛」(thiàⁿ) 不协，音写疑误；释义据 L 栏与 H 栏「風氣痛」。

entries.zh: 破坏；打破、弄破（器物）
entries.en: to break; to smash or destroy (something)
entries.notes: 仅官话栏残，H、M、L 三栏可定；M 栏首音「ping huay」疑即「破壞」(phò-huāi) 之讹写。

entries.zh: 断（绳索）；断绝（交情）
entries.en: to break (a rope); to break off (friendship)
entries.notes: M 栏「tuy／a-tuy」未能与「斷」对应，释义据 L 栏「quebrar como soga, o la amistad」与 H 栏「斷」。

entries.zh: 散；溃散、离散
entries.en: to scatter, disperse; to be routed
entries.notes: M 栏「ey pey」与「散」(sàn) 音不协，释义据 L 栏「quebrar」（溃散）与 H 栏「散」。
